metaDescription: Digital marketing for Nashville businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for music, healthcare, hospitality and local services.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Nashville businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Nashville is Music City, but it is equally a healthcare headquarters town, a weekend destination and one of the fastest-changing metro areas in the South. We work out which of those cities your customers belong to and build the campaign for them.

sections.heading: Music, healthcare and visitors
paragraphs: The music business is an industry here, not only a stage show. Labels, publishers, studios, managers, touring companies and instrument makers cluster around Music Row and beyond, and thousands of working artists and songwriters need websites, video and audiences of their own.

Healthcare is at least as important to the local economy. HCA Healthcare and many other hospital operators and health service companies are based in and around the city, and Vanderbilt University Medical Center is a major employer. These firms buy software, staffing, consulting and professional services, which makes Nashville a strong business-to-business market.

Then there are the visitors. Lower Broadway's honky-tonks, the Ryman, the Grand Ole Opry and the convention centre fill hotels through much of the year, and the city is a favourite for bachelorette weekends and group trips. These guests plan in group chats, book in advance and decide the rest on their phones once they arrive.

sections.heading: Neighbourhoods and the ring of suburbs
paragraphs: Locals and visitors use different maps. Tourists stay around Broadway, the Gulch and Midtown. Residents eat and shop in East Nashville, Germantown, 12 South, Sylvan Park, the Nations and Wedgewood-Houston, and each has its own feel and loyal following.

Much of the metro's household spending now sits outside the city proper: Franklin and Brentwood in Williamson County, Murfreesboro and Smyrna to the southeast, Mount Juliet, Hendersonville and Gallatin to the east and north. Traffic is heavy, so people choose businesses close to home or work.
bullets: Separate pages and targeting for the neighbourhoods and suburbs you serve.
Different campaigns for residents and for visitors, since they search for different things at different times.
A Google Business Profile with current photos, hours and booking links.
Vertical video and photography that show the actual place and people.

sections.heading: A city full of newcomers
paragraphs: Nashville has grown rapidly, with people and companies relocating from other parts of the country. New residents arrive without a doctor, a vet, a contractor or a favourite restaurant, and they search for all of them. Older local firms cannot assume their name is known, and new ones have a real opening. Reviews, clear service pages and visibility in map results count for more here than long history.

sections.heading: The Nashville calendar
paragraphs: Spring to autumn is the long busy season for hospitality, peaking around the country music festival in June, summer concerts and autumn football weekends. Conventions and awards shows add shorter bursts. Winter is calmer and suits site rebuilds, photography and planning. Spring storms create sudden demand for roofing and repairs, so trades should have pages and ads prepared.

presence: TDM works with Nashville businesses remotely. Nobody from TDM is stationed in Nashville and we keep no office there. Strategy, design, development and video are delivered online by our team, with scheduled calls and written reports.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Nashville?
faqs.a: No. We work with Nashville businesses remotely, using video calls, shared documents and regular reports.

faqs.q: How do I market to tourists visiting Nashville?
faqs.a: Reach them twice. Before the trip, appear in search results and social feeds for the things groups plan, such as where to eat, stay and go out. During the trip, a complete map listing with strong reviews and photos wins the on-the-spot decision. Make booking simple on a phone.

faqs.q: Can you help a musician or music company with marketing?
faqs.a: Yes. We build artist and company websites, edit video, plan social content and run paid campaigns around releases and tour dates. The plan depends on your goals and where your audience already is.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Nashville?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of the work, including the channels and the amount of creative needed. The quote comes after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long will it take to see results in Nashville?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements, the brief and the competition in your category. We agree the timeline in the plan before work begins.
